verses.text: “Look, I’ve seen all this with my own eyes. I’ve heard it and understood it.
What you know, I know too. I’m every bit your equal.
“I want to speak to the Almighty himself. I want to argue my case with God.
But you make up lies. Every one of you is a doctor who can’t do a thing for me.
If only you’d go completely quiet! That would be the wise thing to do.
Hear me out now. Listen to the case I’m making.
Are you going to say unjust things for God? Are you going to lie on his behalf?
Are you going to play favorites and take God’s side? Are you going to argue his case for him?
Would it go well for you if he looked closely at you? Can you fool him the way you fool a person?
He’ll call you out if you secretly play favorites.
Won’t his majesty scare you? Won’t dread of him come over you?
Your clever sayings are proverbs made of ashes. Your defenses are made of clay.
“Quiet! Leave me alone so I can speak. Whatever happens to me, let it happen.
Why should I take my flesh in my teeth and put my life in my own hands?
Look, he’ll kill me. I have no hope. Still, I’ll defend the way I’ve lived right in front of him.
This too will be my salvation: a godless person wouldn’t come before him.
Listen closely to what I’m saying. Let my statement reach your ears.
Look, I’ve got my case in order. I know I’m in the right.
Who’s going to argue against me? If someone could, I’d go quiet and breathe my last.
“Just don’t do these two things to me, and I won’t hide from your face:
Take your hand far away from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
Then call me and I’ll answer. Or let me speak and you answer me.
How many wrongs and sins have I committed? Show me my disobedience and my sin.
Why hide your face and treat me like your enemy?
Are you going to harass a leaf blowing in the wind? Are you going to chase dry stubble?
You write bitter charges against me and make me answer for the wrongs I did when I was young.
You put my feet in stocks, watch every path I take, and set a boundary for the soles of my feet,
even though I’m wasting away like something rotten, like clothes eaten by moths.
